parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The resource IDs. You can specify at most 50 resource IDs in each call.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description:
The resource type. Valid value:
- service
- serviceinstance
- artifact

example.unifiedCli: aliyun computenestsupplier tag-resources --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --tag Value=Value1 Key=Key1 --resource-type service --resource-id r-xxx --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun computenestsupplier TagResources --region cn-hangzhou --ResourceId.1 'r-xxx' --Tag.1.Key Key1 --Tag.1.Value Value1 --ResourceType service --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou'
